== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo? (Japanese)|Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo?]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67789 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(10, 5, 456, 617)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>acc00b6995b9fd5cc50d09dd991ba47c1764c624c43a3bb52f76e13fd88c4ca0</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
